label: CMake: Build & Run 'Debug - GCC'
command: cmake --preset DebugGCC && cp build/DebugGCC/compile_commands.json . && cmake --build --preset "Debug - GCC"

label: CMake: Build & Run 'Release - GCC'
command: cmake --preset ReleaseGCC && cp build/ReleaseGCC/compile_commands.json . && cmake --build --preset "Release - GCC"

command: cmake --preset DebugClang && cp build/DebugClang/compile_commands.json . && cmake --build --preset "Debug - Clang"

label: CMake: Build & Run 'Release - Clang'
command: cmake --preset ReleaseClang && cp build/ReleaseClang/compile_commands.json . && cmake --build --preset "Release - Clang"
